home.title: Know your soil before you sow.
home.lead: Photograph a patch of your field and enter the numbers from your soil test report. Soil Analytics keeps everything together in one place, so you can see how your soil changes from season to season.
home.steps.title: How it works
home.step1.title: Photograph your soil
home.step1.text: Take a clear photo in daylight. The app checks it for blur and poor light and tells you when a retake would help.
home.step2.title: Add your lab values
home.step2.text: Enter nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium and pH from your soil test report. Organic matter and moisture are optional.
home.step3.title: Get your soil report
home.step3.text: Press Analyse to see your soil health score, what your soil is missing and how fast it may be wearing out. Every result is saved so you can compare seasons.
home.tips.title: Getting a useful photo
home.tip1: Shoot in daylight, out of direct glare.
home.tip2: Fill the frame with bare soil. Leave out plants, shoes and hands.
home.tip3: Hold the phone steady, about 30 cm above the ground.

plan.title: Fertiliser plan
plan.intro: Choose your crop to see what to apply, how much, and when. The amounts are a guide built from standard crop needs and your lab values.
plan.nutrients: Nutrients for your field: nitrogen {n} kg, phosphorus (P₂O₅) {p} kg, potash (K₂O) {k} kg
plan.buy: What to buy for your field
plan.when.sowing: On the day of sowing or planting
plan.when.start: At the start of the season
plan.when.every: About {months} months after the last round
plan.how.prep: Spread evenly, then plough or mix it into the soil.
plan.how.mix: Mix into the soil at sowing. Keep it a few centimetres away from the seed.
plan.how.side: Spread near the plants, not on the leaves, and mix lightly into the soil. Water afterwards if the soil is dry.
plan.how.paddy: Spread when the field has a thin film of water, and do not drain the field for 2 days.
plan.how.gypsum: Spread near the plants at flowering and mix lightly into the soil.
plan.note.title: Good to know
plan.note.1: Do not apply fertiliser just before heavy rain, because it washes away.
plan.note.2: Keep fertiliser a few centimetres away from seeds and young stems, and never on wet leaves.
plan.note.3: Wear gloves, and keep the bags dry and away from children.
plan.note.legume: This crop makes much of its own nitrogen, so only a small amount of urea is advised. Treat the seed with the matching Rhizobium culture.
plan.note.perennial: For trees and plantation crops these amounts are for one year. Ask your agriculture officer for the best months in your area.
plan.note.past: Steps that have already passed are not made up later. Follow the remaining steps only.
plan.note.acid: Your soil is acidic, so lime is included to bring the pH up.
plan.note.alkaline: Your soil is alkaline. Add compost, avoid too much urea, and ask your agriculture officer whether gypsum is needed.
plan.adjust.low: {nutrient} is low in your soil, so the dose is raised by 25%.
plan.adjust.medium: {nutrient} is medium in your soil, so the standard dose is used.
plan.adjust.high: {nutrient} is high in your soil, so the dose is reduced by 25%.
plan.adjust.unknown: There is no lab value for {nutrient}, so the standard dose is used.
plan.model_note: The fertiliser model suggested {name}. This plan is built from standard crop needs and your lab values, so the two can differ.
plan.disclaimer: Doses are guide values and differ by variety, state and season. Confirm with your agriculture officer before buying.

about.title: About
about.lead: What Soil Analytics is, how it was built and who built it.
about.tagline: Helping farmers understand their soil, in their own language.
about.what.text: Soil Analytics reads a soil photo and lab values, scores soil health, ranks suitable crops and gives a step-by-step fertiliser plan. It can read the result aloud, works offline and speaks English, Hindi, Kannada and Tamil.
about.stack.title: Built with
about.journey.title: The journey
about.step.m1.title: Milestone 1: Ingestion
about.step.m1.text: Sign-up and login, soil photo upload with quality checks, lab-value forms and a PostgreSQL database.
about.step.m2.title: Milestone 2: ML analysis
about.step.m2.text: EfficientNet-B0 finds the soil type from the photo, XGBoost suggests a fertiliser, and rating tables give a health score.
about.step.m3.title: Milestone 3: Advice and app
about.step.m3.text: Crop ranking, health trend, step-by-step fertiliser plan, PDF report, voice, an offline-ready phone app, four languages, and a light ONNX image model with a Docker package that fits free servers.
about.step.next.title: Up next: going live
about.step.next.text: Expert check of doses and thresholds, native-speaker review of the translations and a live deployment on a free server.
about.dev.title: The developer
about.dev.text: Final-year B.Tech student in AI and Machine Learning at Kongu Engineering College. Built the machine-learning models, the FastAPI back end and this app.
about.program: Infosys Springboard Internship 7.0 · Team C · Batch 4
about.note: Rating thresholds, crop ranges and fertiliser doses are provisional until an agriculture expert confirms them.
